## Overview
Creative Liberation Engine is an open creative foundation shaped by the imagination of the person using it, turning ideas into finished work without artificial boundaries. `WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine` is the sole canonical repository for the Creative Liberation Engine.

## Community Gift Shelf (7 Zero-Dependency Python Stdlib Tools Unlocked by Visitor Domains)
- [spatial-3d-manifold-auditor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine/main/gifts/spatial_manifold_auditor.py): Watertight 3D Manifold, Winding-Order & Euler Characteristic Auditor (Honoring Spatial, 3D & WebGPU · Run `./bin/cle gifts --run spatial-3d-manifold-auditor`)
- [gpu-kv-cache-roofline-planner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine/main/gifts/kv_cache_roofline_planner.py): PagedAttention KV-Cache VRAM, GQA & Roofline Arithmetic Intensity Planner (Honoring GPU Kernels, Modular MAX & LLM Inference · Run `./bin/cle gifts --run gpu-kv-cache-roofline-planner`)
- [async-utf8-sse-frame-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine/main/gifts/utf8_sse_frame_doctor.py): Stateful Multi-Byte UTF-8 Chunk Boundary & WHATWG SSE Frame Doctor (Honoring Async Python, ASGI & MCP Streaming · Run `./bin/cle gifts --run async-utf8-sse-frame-doctor`)
- [creative-shader-palette-forge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine/main/gifts/cosine_palette_sdf_forge.py): Inigo Quilez Procedural Cosine Palette & GLSL/WGSL Shader Snippet Forge (Honoring Creative Coding, Shaders & Generative Art · Run `./bin/cle gifts --run creative-shader-palette-forge`)
- [cloud-k3d-port-backoff-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine/main/gifts/k3d_port_and_backoff_doctor.py): k3d Local Cluster Port-Collision & Decorrelated-Jitter Backoff Doctor (Honoring Cloud-Native, Kubernetes & Distributed Systems · Run `./bin/cle gifts --run cloud-k3d-port-backoff-doctor`)
- [db-savepoint-isolation-verifier](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine/main/gifts/savepoint_isolation_verifier.py): In-Memory SQLite Nested Savepoint & Double-Entry Idempotency Verifier (Honoring Database ORM, Savepoints & Ledger Integrity · Run `./bin/cle gifts --run db-savepoint-isolation-verifier`)
- [stir-iescs-rosetta-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine/main/gifts/stir_iescs_rosetta_doctor.py): STIR-1.0 Ternary Kleene Wire Framer, IESCS Call-Word Compiler & Plain-English Receipt Doctor (Honoring Agentic Wire Protocols (STIR+IESCS) & Maintainer Shield · Run `./bin/cle gifts --run stir-iescs-rosetta-doctor`)
